description: This file defines the class 'HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_InterchangeBuilder', which is responsible for building and parsing configuration schema interchange objects for the HTMLPurifier library. It includes methods for constructing schema objects from directory files, hashes, and individual directives or namespaces, as well as auxiliary functions for handling array evaluation and ID management.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_InterchangeBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating and populating configuration schema interchange objects, handling directory parsing, directives, namespaces, and validation within the HTMLPurifier configuration schema system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the varParser, either with a provided parser or a default native parser.

methods.name: buildFromDirectory
methods.description: Creates an interchange object by reading configuration files from a specified directory, parsing each valid file, and building the schema.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds an interchange entry (directive or namespace) based on the provided hash data.

methods.name: buildNamespace
methods.description: Builds and adds a namespace to the interchange based on hash data.

methods.name: buildDirective
methods.description: Builds and adds a directive to the interchange based on hash data, parsing various attributes and options.

methods.name: evalArray
methods.description: Evaluates a string representing array contents into an actual PHP array.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Converts an array list into a lookup array with true values, for quick existence checks.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Creates an ID object from a string ID.

methods.name: _findUnused
methods.description: Checks for unused keys in the hash and triggers a notice for any keys not accessed.
